title: Nazi discs brought to US via Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: based off of like even, for example, when they retrieved the stuff from Nazi Germany back in the ' 40s and then sent them over here with Operation Paperclip.

plain: Material recovered from Nazi Germany in the 1940s, including disc-shaped craft, is said to have been shipped to the United States through Operation Paperclip, the postwar American effort that brought German scientists and technology over. Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a 300-foot craft in the Indonesian jungle, mentions this in passing as something he was told. He offers it as an example of how the US may have got hold of advanced craft to study and copy.
